paragraphs.source_en: This long shelter which faces a large plain presents Round Head paintings concentrated in two main areas of the wall (Fig. 5-10). On the left side the paintings are located in a deep space under a roof and protected from rain water. On the right side of the shelter there are visible traces of an ancient waterfall; immediately next to it there is a row of at least five life-sized mouflon, in a static posture and facing the waterfall (Fig. 5-11). At least two mouflon are males as their penises and testicles are depicted. There is a difference between the position of the mouflon' tails. Whereas it is downwards on the bigger animals, it is raised up on the smaller animal. If the different size is to indicate different age, the small mouflon represents a young individual with a different kind of behaviour, visible from the position of the tail.

units.source_en: This long shelter which faces a large plain presents Round Head paintings concentrated in two main areas of the wall (Fig. 5-10).
On the left side the paintings are located in a deep space under a roof and protected from rain water.

On the right side of the shelter there are visible traces of an ancient waterfall; immediately next to it there is a row of at least five life-sized mouflon, in a static posture and facing the waterfall (Fig. 5-11).
At least two mouflon are males as their penises and testicles are depicted.
There is a difference between the position of the mouflon' tails.
Whereas it is downwards on the bigger animals, it is raised up on the smaller animal.
If the different size is to indicate different age, the small mouflon represents a young individual with a different kind of behaviour, visible from the position of the tail.

paragraphs.source_en: These mouflon were placed deliberately next to the waterfall which is confirmed by the fact that the interior of the shelter, and better protected against rain, is almost empty. Also the fact that all animals are oriented towards the water may be significant. The muzzle of the first big mouflon of the row is very near the falling water and the head of the small mouflon is even eroded by it. When water was running down the wall it would appeared as a herd near a water course. Under the panel with the mouflon there are five oval kettles with a dark patina located at the point on the floor where the waterfall was passing, so that their connection to water is plausible (Fig. 5-12). The waterfall, the paintings and the kettles seem thus to be interrelated.

paragraphs.source_en: The situation in which mouflon or antelope are painted next to a waterfall is recurrent all over the Tassili. Can we hypothesize a symbolic meaning in the association of water with these animals? Although such association appears plausible, the situation is probably more complex since there are cases of waterfalls associated to anthropomorphic figures, as in the following site.
